artifact.quantization: symmetric per-output-channel INT8 constant MatMul weights, standard QDQ; activations and remaining operations float32
artifact.size_hash_scope: artifact.bytes/sha256 describe the decoded ONNX; artifact.download describes the actual compressed public asset.

fixed_position_encoding: Official antialiased bicubic positional embedding precomputed exactly once at224px; frozen in ONNX, no retraining

preprocessing.resize: whole crop, pixel-center bilinear, 224 x 224; no center crop

comparison.metric: 1 - cosine similarity between corresponding 384-dimensional patch vectors
comparison.meaning: Relative feature discrepancy for visual inspection, not a calibrated change probability, material label or condition assessment. Self-attention includes context outside each patch.

validation.browser_status: passed actual Chrome with the compiled production-format worker; parent also verified the integrated Vinext/IAB card
validation.graph_optimization: disabled to preserve explicit QDQ graph across native and browser runtimes

browser_parity.scope: Same preprocessed tensors; CPU native versus browserWASM. JPEG decoding can differ slightly by platform.

browser_full_pipeline.scope: One real768px Smith Street source pair; not a benchmark of all phones or proof of detected physical change.

gzip_transport.hosting_note: Opaque .onnx.gzip suffix avoids automatic Content-Encoding decompression observed for .gz in the local hosting stack.

limitations: Natural-image pretrained features have not been calibrated as a NYC aerial change detector.
Matched export bounds do not guarantee pixel-perfect image registration.
Shadows, season, lighting, view reconstruction, parked objects and image processing can change features.
Each cell is a coarse contextual feature; no changed area, structural change, roof condition, flood risk or engineering suitability is inferred.

browser_runtime.execution: single-thread WASM CPU in a dedicated cancellable Web Worker
